purpose: Publish the actual same-M0 center nuclear gradient and four-displacement SCF-precision diagnosis without granting complete-curvature, barrier or mechanism qualification
unknown_numeric_policy: null with reason; an unavailable or uncomputed value is never replaced by zero

scientific_boundaries.authorized_system: Same neutral restricted 26-atom CF3 substrate of M0; PBE0/def2-SVP/ddCOSMO benzene
scientific_boundaries.authorized_points: Fresh center plus C6-y and C10-y positive/negative displacements at h=0.0005 bohr
scientific_boundaries.published_authorship: Original chemical findings and observations retain their original authors

evidence_identity.execution_identity: Actual worker, controller, protocol and analyzer SHA256
evidence_identity.S3: New scientific evidence and unlinked progress edition, preserving prior S1/S2 bytes
evidence_identity.S4: Current registry, fixed S3 links and chained page revision; not the execution commit
evidence_identity.fixed_URL_policy: Use full S3 SHA for the new edition's evidence blob URLs; local binary archives have no invented download URL
evidence_identity.no_self_reference: The current registry contains paths; the page revision binds progress bytes and the preceding revision, never itself or its own future commit

local_test_distribution_policy: tests/ and test/ remain local; publication checks execute no DFT or model APIs and claim no distributed unit tests
